finding: The 15 agent labels are positioned from 3D coordinates and then added as fixed-in-frame objects without any screen-space collision handling. In the rendered film, the labels collapse into a dense horizontal band over the habitat core and become mutually illegible.

candidate_change.scope: label placement only; preserve agent positions, camera, colors, copy, timing, and source data
candidate_change.proposal: Project each label anchor to screen coordinates, then place labels with a deterministic screen-space solver. Try ordered offsets around the projected node (above, below, left, right), reject any candidate whose padded bounding box intersects a previously placed label or the title/stats/footer safe zones, clamp to the 12 px viewport margin, and draw a short leader line from the chosen box to the node. If no local candidate is valid, place the label in a deterministic left/right side lane with its leader line rather than allowing overlap.
acceptance: pairwise intersection area between visible agent-label boxes is 0 px² in every sampled frame after labels appear
each visible label has at least 4 px gap from another label box and does not intersect title, stats, WORLD, task, receipt, or footer text
all 15 source agent IDs remain represented, with the existing 17-character truncation unchanged

evidence.observation: Every agent creates a Text label at pos + [0, 0.27, 0], and the complete labels VGroup is passed to add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects; no overlap test, safe-area reservation, or fallback placement is present.
The snapshot contains 15 selected agents (13 working, 2 idle), so the label population is large enough to stress a shared screen band.
At frame 72 (about 4.8 s), after labels are visible, the agent IDs occupy the same narrow central horizontal region; an enlarged crop shows adjacent glyphs drawn over one another.

falsifier: Render the candidate at 854x480 with the same source snapshot and inspect frames 72, 90, 120, and 150. If any visible pair of agent-label bounding boxes intersects, if any label is clipped or unreadable at normal scale, or if any source agent ID is missing, this collision-avoidance candidate is falsified.

next_measurement.render: Render the candidate with the canonical source and unchanged 854x480/15 fps settings.
